# Conference data table

## Reading the evidence

These are specific, dated observations, not general recommendations.
General lessons require three independent conferences across two organizing bodies, or a structural reason independent of year.
See [How to read lessons](../start/how-to-read-lessons.md) for promotion and ranking.
The pinned reference year is 2026; ages 0–3 are recent, 4–8 are mid, and older evidence is stale-prone.
General lessons rank first; specific lessons sort by year descending, confidence (observed, reported, hearsay), then first ledger ID.
Conflicting counts and populations remain separate; stream viewers, sprinters and registrants are not interchangeable.
A dash means no matching ledger evidence; it does not mean zero attendance.
